authority: Existing request shape: register harness_session, claim/ACK native_session plus live pid/proc_start; no wire/schema/provenance field added.

Only current native-attested Copilot ownership can be automatically rebound after an exact prior incarnation is observed absent/replaced. State text is never death evidence; liveness errors and live/unverified owners refuse.

Slow host and prior-owner liveness observation stays outside global exclusion. Current ownership fields of dead owner and any exact prebind target are revalidated under the shared mutation lock before writes.

Ordinary same-native resume retains its Pij address and current metadata/semantic Hold. A different native session gets a new address and may release a proven-dead native pane owner, leaving its jobs untouched.
Explicit retirement remains terminal. A->B->A reopening uses a fresh Pij address without old queue inheritance; no inference of cleared attestation from session/state.

Verified exact preallocated S2 is explicit new-address intent and may retire dead native S1 even for the same native session. Live S1 or stale/invalid prebind refuses; S1 queue/journal never becomes S2 work.

Completed/reclaimed queue attempts re-loop/re-observe rather than failing the consumer. An old observer never hands out, retries or ACKs the successor attempt. Same-native pane change is a held re-observation outcome, not a gate-policy change.
